mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sn_item WHERE sn = #{sn} AND pi_no = #{pi} AND origin = 'GEN'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM sn_item WHERE GROUP BY status
SELECT bill_no, bill_seq, MIN(material_code) material_code, COUNT(*) n, MIN(sn) a, MAX(sn) b FROM sn_item WHERE GROUP BY bill_no, bill_seq ORDER BY bill_no, bill_seq

SELECT DISTINCT i.delivery_batch_no FROM sn_item i JOIN sn_delivery_batch b ON b.batch_no = i.delivery_batch_no WHERE AND i.status = 'TO_PUSH' AND b.result IN ('UNCONFIRMED','FAILED') ORDER BY i.delivery_batch_no
SELECT DISTINCT factory_code FROM sn_item WHERE
SELECT DISTINCT bill_no FROM sn_item WHERE AND factory_code IS NULL
SELECT DISTINCT seq_pi_no FROM sn_item WHERE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_item WHERE AND seq_pi_no <> pi_no
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sn_gen_job WHERE running_pi IN #{p})
SELECT id FROM sn_item WHERE ORDER BY seq_pi_no, seq_dec FOR UPDATE

SELECT bill_no, bill_seq, COUNT(*) n, SUM(status <> 'PENDING_ALLOC') a, MIN(sn) first_sn, MAX(sn) last_sn, MIN(factory_code) f, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(factory_code, '')) nf, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT status) st FROM sn_item WHERE GROUP BY bill_no, bill_seq
SELECT seq_pi_no, COUNT(*) n FROM sn_item WHERE GROUP BY seq_pi_no
mapper.sql: id, sn, factory_code, pi_no, customer_code, bill_no, bill_seq, material_code, rev, gen_org_code, gen_bill_no, gen_bill_seq, seq_pi_no, seq_dec, length_text, attach_no, rule_version_id, gen_batch, status, delivery_mode, delivery_batch_no, mes_holder, created_at, allocated_at, delivered_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sn_item WHERE id IN #{i}
mapper.update: UPDATE sn_pi_counter SET generated_qty = GREATEST(generated_qty - #{n}, 0), updated_at = #{now} WHERE pi_no = #{pi}
